spec2def(shfolder.dll shfolder.spec)

# shfolder.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/shfolder-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(shfolder shfolder-cargo shfolder.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
add_dependencies(shfolder psdk)
